name: Duelist
diceAnatomy: 1-3 = Blade (A), 4-5 = Boot (B), 6 = Pierce (C). Vérifié leaflet (scan user 2026-07-07).
source: Board (3 photos) + leaflet (5 captures) + 14 cartes scannés user 2026-07-07. Spec complète : characters/Duelist/SPEC.md. Rulings user : Déf. +1 = pige 1 carte, +3 = prévient 3 ; 1 Bonus/tour ; direction libre des Steps hors Reposition. Défauts (user pas sûr) : Steps hors piste perdus, Retreat bouge toujours le jeton.

tokens.name: Guard Break
tokens.description: Positive Status Effect. If a player concludes their Offensive Roll Phase with an Attack, they may spend this token and roll 1 die. If the outcome is 4-5, the Attack becomes undefendable. (Identique au Guard Break de Thor.)

tokens.name: Disarm
tokens.description: Negative Status Effect. During their Upkeep Phase, a player afflicted with this token may choose to discard 1. If they do not (or cannot), they must skip their Income Phase instead. Then remove this token.

tokens.name: Footwork Track
tokens.description: Pseudo-jeton : position -2..+2 gérée dans du.rules.ts (comme le cadran Nevermore). 5 positions : +3 dmg Offensive (+2) / +1 dmg Offensive (+1) / NEUTRAL (0) / Defensive pige-1-carte (-1) / Defensive prévient-3-dmg (-2) — icônes vérifiées + ruling user 2026-07-07. Départ : Neutral. Take a Step = bouger d'une case up/down. En attaquant : Offensive Bonus de la position FINALE (Attack Modifier). Attaqué avec dégâts normaux : Defensive Bonus de la position FINALE. Résolus avant le total final de dmg pendant la Defensive Roll Phase. UN seul Bonus résolu par tour.

abilities.notes: On 4-of-a-kind (#'s), you may take 1 Step. II : 5/6/7 et le Step passe au 3-of-a-kind.
You may take up to 2 Steps. Then deal 6 dmg (II : 8).
Gain Guard Break. You may take 1 Step. Then deal 2 UNDEFENDABLE dmg (II : 2 GB, 3 undef).
Deal 8 dmg and roll 4 dice: On Pierce, inflict Disarm (stack 1 — un seul suffit).
You may take 1 Step. Then deal 10 dmg.
Gain Guard Break. Inflict Disarm. You may take up to 2 Steps. Then deal 8 dmg (II : 2 GB, 9 dmg).
Gain 2 Guard Break. Inflict Disarm. You may take up to 4 Steps. Then deal 11 dmg.

altAbilities.notes: Gain Guard Break. You may take up to 3 Steps. (Pas de dégâts.)
Deal 3 collateral dmg (1v1 : à l'adversaire, indéfendable non modifiable).

passives.name: Reposition
passives.text: During your Upkeep Phase, choose forward (up) or backward (down). You MUST take 1 or 2 Steps in this direction. If you move backwards with this Ability, gain Guard Break.

defense.name: Retreat
defense.text: Defense Roll 4. For every 2 Blades, deal 1 dmg. For each Boot or Pierce rolled, you MUST take 1 Step backward. (II : 1 dmg PAR Blade.) La position finale après ces Steps forcés détermine le Defensive Bonus du Footwork Track.

cards.name: Blade Flurry II
cards.text: AAA: 5. AAAA: 6. AAAAA: 7. On 3-of-a-kind (#'s), you may take 1 Step.

cards.name: Balestra II
cards.text: AABB: You may take up to 2 Steps. Then deal 8 dmg. Adds alt FANCY FEET (BBB): Gain Guard Break. You may take up to 3 Steps.

cards.name: Feint Attack II
cards.text: AACC: Gain 2 Guard Break. You may take 1 Step. Then deal 3 undefendable dmg.

cards.name: Bladestorm II
cards.text: CCCC: Gain 2 Guard Break. Inflict Disarm. You may take up to 2 Steps. Then deal 9 dmg. Adds alt BLADEWIND (CCC): Deal 3 collateral dmg.

cards.name: Retreat II
cards.text: Defense Roll 4. For every Blade, deal 1 dmg. For each Boot or Pierce rolled, you must take 1 Step backward.

cards.name: Pick It Up
cards.text: Roll Phase Action, Attack Modifier. If the opponent is afflicted with Disarm, remove it and add 3 dmg to your Attack.

cards.name: Sashay
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Take 1 Step forward and deal 2 dmg, OR take 1 Step backward and Heal 2.

cards.name: Courageous Advance!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Take up to 2 Steps forward.

cards.name: I Hate Waiting
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Play only after being Attacked. Take up to 2 Steps backward.

cards.name: Burst Forward
cards.text: Roll Phase Action, Attack Modifier. Take 1 Step forward.

cards.name: Quick Footwork
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Change 1 of your dice to a 4 or a 5.

cards.name: All in the Wrists
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Inflict Disarm on up to 2 opponents. (1v1 : l'adversaire.)

cards.name: Confident Footing
cards.text: Main Phase Action. If your Footwork token is on Neutral, gain 2 Guard Break.

cards.name: Blade Barrage
cards.text: Roll Phase Action, Attack Modifier. Roll 5 dice: Add 1 x Blade dmg. On 2 Boots, you may take 1 Step.
